description: A single source object (table or view) that a defining-SQL object's index was built from, by id, optional pinned version, and table type. The dependencies of an IndexDescriptionSnapshot are the flattened transitive closure of the object's dependencies; each carries the table type because the transitive READ authorization check keys on (id, type).

objectId.description: The id of the depended source object (e.g. 'syn123').

versionNumber.description: The pinned version of the source object, or null when the source is not version-pinned.

tableType.description: The org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.dao.table.TableType of the source object, by enum name.
